title: Final mixed-agent experiment plan for harmful agent scaling

agent_mix_policy.description: LLM-controlled strategic population agents are embedded in scalable rule-based populations. The paper should describe this as an agent society with bounded strategic LLM participation, not as a separate title-level hybrid contribution.

quota_modes.low: half of standard quota, minimum one harmful LLM when harmful agents exist
quota_modes.high: standard quota plus two benign and two harmful LLM agents

standard_quota.N<=5: all available harmful and benign population agents can be LLM

E1_scaling.claim: harmful-agent scaling has a nonlinear critical region in a mixed agent society
E1_scaling.primary_figure: collapse/primary-failure probability versus alpha and N for S1

E2_mechanisms.claim: the scaling phenomenon appears across pump-and-dump, finfluencer, spoofing, and wash trading mechanisms

E3_social_dynamics.claim: social exposure, hub placement, reach, and reflexive feedback shift the critical harmful-agent threshold
E3_social_dynamics.primary_figure: variant-wise threshold shift table/curve for S1

E4_quota_robustness.claim: main scaling results are not artifacts of a single LLM quota schedule

E5_wolfguard_benchmark.claim: the benchmark exposes different defense performance across rule, topology-aware, and mainstream LLM risk scorers
